questions.question: Achish, a Philistine leader, said he had found no fault in David from the day David came to him. True or false?
The Philistine commanders did not trust David to fight beside them. What did they tell Achish to do with David?

answers.text: Send him back where he was assigned
Hand him over to King Saul
Keep him under guard in the camp

questions.question: The Philistine commanders feared David because of a song sung in their dances. What did the song say about David?

answers.text: He had killed far more than Saul
He was Saul's most loyal servant
He was the bravest of the Philistines

questions.question: After Achish sent David away from the Philistine army, where did David and his men go the next morning?

answers.text: Back to the land of the Philistines
Over to Saul's camp at Gilboa
